definitions.gloss: history of science; the academic study of how science developed
definitions.explanation: The field that studies how scientific knowledge, methods, and institutions developed over time. Also used loosely for the historical record itself, as in a turning point in the history of science.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{科学史|かがくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I studied the history of science at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{科学史|かがくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧だろう。
examples.english: This discovery will surely go down in the history of science.

examples.japanese: {科学史|かがくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ほど⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んだ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Reading the history of science shows you how fierce the debate was over ideas we now take for granted.

notes:
⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧ (science) + ⟦{史|し}→〜史：28471_shi⟧ (history). The ⟦{史|し}→〜史：28471_shi⟧ suffix names a field's history and attaches freely: {日本史|にほんし} (Japanese history), {美術史|びじゅつし} (art history), {医学史|いがくし} (history of medicine).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {科学史|かがくし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study the history of science
- {科学史|かがくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to go down in the history of science
- {科学史|かがくし}⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧: a discovery in the history of science
- {科学史|かがくし}⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: historian of science

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧: science — the subject itself, not its history
- {技術史|ぎじゅつし}: history of technology — often paired with it, but focused on tools and industry
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧: chemistry — a homophone of ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧; speakers say ばけがく to disambiguate in speech
